C1.rule: Mechanical, one owned file, fully specified

C2.rule: Bounded implementation or tests, one or two owned files and their tests

C3.rule: Cross-module design; changes a contract every project inherits

C4.rule: Planning, merging, reconciling, another project's real data, a sponsor decision

phases.name: One tracker per project
phases.goal: Every project has one tracker page covering all its proposals, readable at a glance: filters across the top, work shown as blocks, and a list when the detail matters. A proposal gets a tracker of its own only when the sponsor asks for one.
phases.exit: common-rules publishes its one tracker, the card and conformance read it, and the per-proposal pages are retired except where the sponsor asked for one.

phases.name: Research
phases.goal: Questions that need reading, not writing, before they become items, a proposal, or a decline.
phases.exit: Every X row is done only when it becomes items, a numbered proposal, or a recorded decline with the reason -- never a report nobody acted on.

items.title: tracker board: the project's one tracker page
items.what: tools/tracker/board.py renders every ledger in docs/proposals into docs/proposals/tracker/index.html: a filter bar (search, proposal, status, owner, tier), one summary block per proposal, a board of item blocks by status, a list view, and open asks. Deterministic; carries each ledger's digest, and --check compares them. No external script; filters work in the page itself.
items.done: common-rules' three ledgers render into one page the lead has looked at in both themes; rendering twice is byte-identical; --check goes stale when any ledger changes, is added or is removed.

items.title: The chain reads the project page, not one page per proposal
items.what: ledger.py accepts a `tracker` key (own: true, by, at, quote) for a proposal the sponsor asked to track separately. derecord's pre-commit hook renders the project page whenever a ledger is staged, and a per-proposal page only for a ledger that declares its own; warmup's chain, conformance item 2 and new-proposal follow the same rule.
items.done: A scratch project with two ledgers commits one page; a ledger declaring its own tracker also gets its own page; the card and conformance name the project page when it is stale.

items.title: Publishing the project page
items.what: tracker published --project records docs/proposals/tracker/index.published.json; the card's 'page changed since last publish' line and conformance item 10 read it; skills/warmup and the lead prompt name the one page. A project that declares plan_page keeps publishing that page.
items.done: After a ledger commit the card names the project page until it is republished and recorded; per-proposal sidecars are read only for a ledger that declares its own tracker.

items.title: common-rules on one tracker
items.what: Retire common-rules' per-proposal tracker pages and the proposal 21 sidecar, publish the project page, record it, and write the CHANGELOG entry with a Standard change line and the /standard checklist wording for items 2 and 10.
items.done: bin/conformance --project common-rules reads 12 of 12 on the new rule; one published tracker URL for common-rules.

items.title: PhotoVault app and engine move to one tracker
items.what: Both sessions implement the Standard change at their next /warmup; the engine's hand-kept artifact 32e06e90 and the app's declared plan_page are named in the entry.
items.done: Both projects' conformance reads 12 of 12 on the new rule.
